transcript: What happens if you sleep under 5 hours then push through your morning watering? I grab the book to see what gives way first. Attention starts slipping, making simple tasks harder to follow. Forming new memories becomes more difficult. Reaction time slows, increasing the chance of mistakes and accidents. Your mood may become more irritable or low. Hunger signals can shift toward more calorie-dense foods. Repeated short nights can make blood sugar harder to control. Blood pressure can rise with ongoing sleep restriction. Your immune defenses may become less effective. Severe tiredness can trigger brief micro-sleeps without warning. During a micro-sleep, your brain briefly stops responding normally. One short night usually brings mostly temporary effects. But regularly sleeping under 5 hours can compound strain across multiple systems. Sleep is not empty time, it is essential maintenance. Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
